## Skill trigger: `ddlapi-using`

When writing TypeScript that imports `@netcracker/qubership-apihub-ddlapi` —

# api-diff Testing

## Skill trigger: `api-diff-testing`

When writing or reviewing `test/**/*.test.ts` files that contain api-diff diff tests — AsyncAPI specs or parser-built fixtures for any spec type (OpenAPI, JSON Schema, GraphQL, ddlapi) — apply the `api-diff-testing` skill.
